thread:
megan: idea: instead of full failover when Dedicated saturates, route to a small Hosted 'quarantine' affinity with degraded SLOs. protects other dedicated tenants.
aditya: sounds good. probe-first migration? small sample then ramp?
megan: yes. probe-first + affinity header so hosted can opt into low-priority queue.
samir: cache/KV mismatch is main risk. propose a migration marker so Hosted can remap prefixes or treat session as cold intentionally.
courtney: add telemetry events `quarantine_start`/`quarantine_end` with reason codes and a billing tag. UI shows "Degraded - Quarantine".
liz: runbook/CLI: `rictl tenant quarantine <id>` / `rictl tenant restore <id>`. include rollback path.
aditya: action: i'll spec probe config and token envelope.
samir: i'll sketch KV marker.
courtney: i'll add telemetry + billing mapping.
liz: i'll update runbook + CLI stubs.
megan: agreed. short RFC next week and canary on internal tenants.
